author: Porkyyy
body:
So a few months ago I asked when "recent posts" is getting fixed..
"a few months ago"
"months"

The answer I got was 'when a new forum update comes out'
I mean come on, that's not even an answer. Could we at least have a date?

Or if you don't even plan on fixing it could you just tell us instead of making us wait ages for the answer?

I mean, I'm not bashing any staff members or anything, but it just seems like a lot of questions go unanswered and it just seems a bit unorganized to me.

Now I know you'll say 'oh we have to focus on getting more players before improving the website', but let's be honest... with OCN shutting down there's been more players coming onto Avicus recently (both forums and ingame) so honestly I think we should fix up some things that are wrong with the website.

Anyways, just say whether or not you're going to be fixing this (if so, give an approximate date?), since the "recent posts" tab hasn't been working since early this year.. that's months.

anyways, yeah that's my little rant, thanks.
